recommendation: Keep the fixed commit as-is. It preserves the published safety-page and CDS-page wording while making the formal safety-entries CodeSystem expose the decision-support checks introduced for FHIR-24867.
issue_request: FHIR-24867 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Clinical Decision Support change request asking for Clinical Safety checklist language cautioning against assuming EHR data is correct before risk-model or decision-support use, with links from decision support topics and related resources.
initial_application: Commit d0cd856afd919b36f213916cc1e9af5c7b0679e8, linked from the Jira comments and HL7/fhir#2834, added a Decision Support Related Safety Checks section to source/safety.html and a safety checklist link to source/clinicalreasoning-cds-on-fhir.html. Those narrative changes remain present in current source.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists both safety.html and clinicalreasoning-cds-on-fhir.html as current pages, and source/fhir.ini actively includes source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml as safety-entries. The safety page says checklist items are formally referenceable through that CodeSystem, but the active CodeSystem lacked the five FHIR-24867 decision-support entries, and three of the corresponding safety page anchors used absolute URL strings rather than local code names. Confluence only added the 2020 FHIR-I assignment-to-CDS context, and Zulip searches found no conflicting rationale.
reconciliation: Added confirm-data-validity, clinician-judgement, minimum-necessary, secure-access, and appropriate-use to source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml, and normalized the matching minimum-necessary, secure-access, and appropriate-use anchors in source/safety.html.
source_changes: source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml: added the five FHIR-24867 decision-support checklist concepts to the active safety-entries CodeSystem.
source/safety.html: changed the minimum-necessary, secure-access, and appropriate-use anchors from absolute safety-entry URLs to local code-name anchors.
